['RAG Deutsche Steinkohle AG '].company_description: RAG Deutsche Steinkohle AG, also known as RAG, was a German company that operated in the coal mining industry. The company played a significant role in the coal mining industry in Saarland, which ended in June 2012. Additionally, Wilhelm Werner Müller, a German businessman and politician, served as CEO of RAG AG from 2003, overseeing the reduction of Germany's dependence on coal in a socially responsible manner.
